en.title: Cause, means and purpose
en.summary: Some prepositions tell why, how or for what purpose.

paragraphs: Besides place and time, prepositions can tell why something happens (cause), how it is done (means) and what it is for (purpose). Many of these phrases are fixed and have to be learned as units.

items: The flight was cancelled **because of** the fog.

blocks.html:
PrepositionExample
because ofWe stayed in because of the rain.
due to / owing toThe delay was due to a strike.
thanks toThanks to you, we won.
from, out ofShe died from cancer. He did it out of kindness.
forHe was punished for lying.

PrepositionExample
by + transportby car, by train, by plane
by + methodby e-mail, by hand, by mistake
by + -ingHe learned by listening.
with + toolShe cut it with a knife.
withoutHe left without a coat.
on foot, on the phoneI came on foot.

paragraphs: For + noun or -ing gives the purpose of a thing: This room is for meetings; a knife is for cutting. To + base verb gives the purpose of an action: I went to the shop to buy bread.

blocks.html:
ForTo
a tool for cuttingI use a tool to cut.
a pill for headachesI took a pill to stop the pain.
What is it for?Why did you come? To see you.

items: Wrong: **I went there for to see you.** Right: **to see you**
Wrong: **He came with the bus.** Right: **by bus**
Wrong: **Because the rain, we stayed.** Right: **Because of the rain**
Wrong: **I opened it by a key.** Right: **with a key**

ro.title: Cauză, mijloc și scop
ro.summary: Prepozițiile arată motivul unei acțiuni, mijlocul folosit pentru realizarea ei sau scopul urmărit.

paragraphs: Prepozițiile leagă cuvintele între ele în propoziție. Ele explică de ce se întâmplă o acțiune. De asemenea, arată mijlocul folosit sau scopul dorit.
Pentru cauză folosim des grupul «din cauza» cu forma de genitiv. Pentru mijloc sau instrument folosim prepoziția «cu» urmată de acuzativ. Pentru a exprima scopul folosim prepoziția «pentru».

blocks.html:
ÎnțelesPrepozițieExemplu
Cauzădin cauza (+ genitiv)Nu am ieșit **din cauza** ploii.
Cauzăde (+ acuzativ)Copilul plânge **de** foame.
Mijloccu (+ acuzativ)El scrie tema **cu** un creion.
Transportcu (+ acuzativ)Noi călătorim **cu** trenul.
Scoppentru (+ acuzativ)Facem pregătiri **pentru** petrecere.
Scoppentru a (+ infinitiv)Am venit **pentru a discuta**.
